Honda, Sumo Champion is another printing of this one Oracle card (the ruling is the note Wizards gives such pairs, as Arvinox, the Mind Flail's for "Mind Flayer, the Shadow", exempt in rulings-P067); the card data has one Oracle card, named Baldin, Century Herdmaster, and no card or object can be named E.
